description: Defines the Mesh class and its nested Builder class for 3D mesh representation, including vertex data management, primitive types, and related methods.

classes.name: Mesh
classes.description: Represents a 3D mesh with vertex data, indices, and primitive type.

classes.name: Mesh::Builder
classes.description: Builder pattern class for constructing Mesh instances.

classes.name: Mesh::VertexArray
classes.description: Template class for managing vertex attribute arrays with automatic stride handling.
